story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain from code, not observed pixels. A round ring with a turning compass tape sits over dry land then pulls back to a lattice tower with a truck at its foot. 16 of 56 lens rings light with a February 2027 plan tag. Inside the ring a plume rises and a flag box locks, an alert card slides to the truck and lands as a bubble on the dash phone. A dash clock opens an estimated ten-minute window. The plume keeps burning under the locked flag and a dashed line from the truck stops short of a fire-station badge. A visor calendar shows no red mark. A blank record's How much sooner field stays empty. The plan folder waits on state approval under the still-turning ring.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The film opens on an ambiguous ring whose turning is ticks only, so the tower arrives at 2.5 s. The mechanism is clear by about 17 s, then the same limits as A. It ends on the HUD ring over a static desk inset with tiny labels.
story_review.weakest_transition: s7 to s8. The record desk and commission desk are the same drawing with an unsourced causal because.
